The MID400S-ND is the DigiKey Part Number for the MID400S, a surface-mount (SMD) optically isolated AC line monitor optocoupler manufactured by onsemi (formerly Fairchild Semiconductor).

Key Details & Specifications

• Function: AC line-to-logic interface device used for AC line monitoring, line-down detection, and time-delay isolation switching.
• Package: 8-pin Surface Mount Device (SMD) / Gull-wing (MDIP style).
• Input: Back-to-back GaAs LED diodes that accept and convert alternating current (AC) into light energy.
• Output: High-gain detector circuit driving an open-collector transistor logic output (goes low when AC is detected, high otherwise).
• Isolation Voltage: 2,500 VACRMS (1 minute, UL1577).
• Status: Obsolete and no longer manufactured by onsemi.

Pinout (8-Pin DIP/SMD)

• Pin 1: AC Live
• Pin 2 & 4: No Connection (NC)
• Pin 3: AC Neutral
• Pin 5: Ground
• Pin 6: \(V_{OUT}\) (Logic Output, open collector)
• Pin 7: Auxiliary / Time-delay capacitor connection
• Pin 8: \(V_{CC}\) (Supply voltage, max 7V)
